name: Aerogram or letter sheet
definition: sheet or card with a printed stamp, issued by a postal administration, that folds and seals to form its own envelope; aerograms, letter sheets and lettercards.
reason: Post office sells aerogrammes beside stamped envelopes and postal cards; no stationery kind covers a self-folding sheet. Airmail stays a postal_service value (F3-O4).
Same self-folding form as the aerogram; airmail use is an attribute (F3-O4).
Folded card with perforated edges that forms its own envelope: same form, one kind.

name: Newspaper wrapper
definition: paper band with a printed stamp, issued by a postal administration, to wrap newspapers or printed matter for posting.
reason: Postal stationery type named apart by the fetched page; neither envelope nor card covers a band.
A compulsory surcharge stamp is a postal_service value of an adhesive stamp, like semi-postal and postage due (F3-O4).
A revenue stamp used for postage; the use is an attribute of the revenue stamp.
Mint stamps in the post's folder: the stamps with unit = set; K-1 keeps the mint and proof set as the only set kind.
A year's issues packaged by the post: unit = set (K-1).
Packaging of a stamp issue: unit = set (K-1).

name: Philatelic numismatic cover
definition: cover issued by a postal administration that carries stamps cancelled for an issue together with a coin or medal mounted in it.
reason: Post sells PNCs under their own name; the coin makes it more than a first-day cover; administration-issued covers are F3 (K-118).
A token made to be used up in one coin-operated game is E1 (memo section 9, R-0); Numista node becomes an alias row.
A token good for one ride is a good-for piece issued by a private operator.
Casino and poker chips are E1 (key step 25, memo section 9).

name: Vending or service-machine token
definition: token issued to buy a product or a service from a coin-operated machine that is not a game, such as a dispenser, parking meter, car wash, laundry or telephone.
reason: Numista files dispenser, parking and car-wash tokens apart; neither transit nor deposit kind covers them; memo section 4 lists them as purpose kinds.
Pays a parking meter: a service-machine token; the business is an attribute (4b).
Pays a car-wash machine: a service-machine token; the business is an attribute (4b).
Exchanged for goods or a stated value at an event: a trade token or good-for piece.
Issued to admit a member to a rite: an admission token, not a devotional object.
A token made for devotion, luck or protection and carried is F4; worn A3 (K-117).

name: Coin weight
definition: weight made to check the weight of one coin denomination on a balance.
reason: Numista and the British Museum list coin weights apart; made to serve one coin, so the coin-and-note parts leaf (S3).
Game money is E1 (K-120); prop and souvenir notes stay F3.2.4.02.

name: Admission, attendance or voting token
definition: token issued to admit the holder to a meeting, place or rite, to record attendance, or to cast a vote, communion tokens included.
reason: New leaf F3.4.5 Tokens for admission and record on the leaf axis (what the token stands for); memo section 4 lists voting and attendance.
A postal order kept as an object is F5 (K-27).
A traveller's cheque kept as an object is F5 (K-27).
Paper entitlement, not issued to circulate as money; metal ration tokens stay F3.4.2.02.
A voucher redeemable only with its issuer is F5 (key step 15, memo section 9).
A debt instrument like a cheque is F5 (K-27); private notes issued to circulate as money stay F3.4.4.01 (F-16).
Existing kind Challenge coin or membership medal.
Existing kind Stamp hinge or mount; maker brands are named forms.
Existing kind Stamp hinge or mount; hinge against mount is a form attribute.
Numista nests them under membership medals; given to members or donors of an organisation.
A medal made for devotion is F4 loose, A3 when made to be worn (K-107).
Prop or souvenir note names demonstration notes in its definition (K-120).
A booklet class buyers ask for by name (Isle of Man, USPS); non-maker named form of the stamp booklet.
Issue class of the stamps inside: issue_class attribute.
A unit of stamps: a unit value like block and sheet (F3-O4).
Full-size or miniature is an attribute of medals (memo 4b).
Shown only in a gavel set with its block; the set is the gavel with unit = set.
